zh: 一个产品算重复，只要存在另一个三项完全相同的产品。把完全相同的产品归为一组来看。
一组只有1个产品时贡献0；一组有c≥2个产品时，组内每一个都有伙伴，贡献c（而不是c−1）。
用哈希表以(名称, 价格, 重量)为键计数（名称可能是空串），遍历所有组，把计数≥2的组的计数累加后输出。
en: A product counts as a duplicate as soon as some other product matches it in all three fields. Look at identical products as one group.
A group with a single product contributes 0; a group with c≥2 products contributes c (not c−1), because every product in it has a partner.
Count with a hash map keyed by (name, price, weight) (the name may be an empty string), then go over all groups and add up the counts that are ≥2.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count by the (name,price,weight) tuple and add up the full counts of all groups that appear ≥2 times.

## Proof of correctness

If a group occurs once, its only product has no other identical product and contributes 0; if it occurs at least twice, every product in the group can use another one as a witness, so all of them count. Different groups are mutually exclusive because they differ in at least one field, so summing group by group neither double counts nor misses anything.

## Complexity

Expected time O(n), space O(n); names have at most 10 characters.
